name: Ugliest Catch

features.name: Enhancer Cells
features.description: Reveal Fisherman Wilds, Big Berta or xWays.

review:
A 5x5 fishing game with locked positions. Each scatter opens the locked spots on its reel, and Enhancer Cells above and below each reel can reveal a Fisherman Wild, Big Berta, xWays or normal symbols.

Fish trophies and Big Berta carry random multipliers, so opening up the grid and landing Berta in the right place is the dream. Extreme volatility, 50,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
